title: AI, Tools and Transformation
summary: Benedict Evans analyzes how AI is fundamentally changing the nature of software tools and development, drawing parallels with historical technology transformations to explain the current AI revolution and its broader implications for the tech industry.
problem_solved: Explains how AI is transforming the tools we use to build software and what this means for the technology industry at a fundamental level.
why_valuable: Benedict Evans provides deeply researched, long-term perspective on technology trends that helps industry professionals understand the strategic implications of AI transformation.
